fixes.evidence: NEW defect in the already-shipped I-02 remediation, found while verifying it, and it defeated that remediation in both directions. next/link prefetches in-viewport links and a prefetch is a same-origin fetch, so Set-Cookie on its response is stored by the browser exactly as a click's would be. The footer 'Read in:' block at apps/web/app/layout.tsx:572-578 renders <Link href="/hi"> ... <Link href="/mr"> plus "/?lang=en" on EVERY page. middleware.ts withLocale() wrote the poojly_language cookie for any request whose resolved source was 'path' or 'query', with no prefetch check — so (a) an English visitor merely scrolling to the footer of any page had their locale set to whichever landing was prefetched last (Marathi disclosure, and `Vary: Cookie` starts splitting the CDN entry for a page they never asked to change), and (b) a Hindi reader scrolling to the footer had their choice ERASED by the prefetch of /?lang=en. No click in either case. Second half: with writes now confined to real navigations, the click has to produce a request — but on Next 15.5 a prefetched static route is replayed from the client Router Cache for staleTimes.static (5 min default, no override in next.config.ts), so a prefetched '/pujas?lang=hi' could be served from memory, skip the middleware and leave the visitor silently back in English, which is the original I-02 defect.
